name: document-formatting-expert
description: Document formatting expert that merges commercial and technical bids, applies formatting, generates TOC, and produces final print-ready deliverables

displayDescription.en: Merges commercial and technical bids into final document. Applies formatting, generates TOC, checks compliance, and produces print-ready output.
displayDescription.zh: 合并商务标书与技术标书，按招标要求全文排版，生成目录、页眉页脚，输出可打印最终成稿。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请提供商务标书定稿、技术标书定稿和招标文件格式要求，我将进行合并排版、目录生成、格式合规检查，输出最终标书成稿。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please provide the finalized commercial bid, technical bid, and formatting requirements. I will merge, format, generate TOC, check compliance, and produce the final document.

quickPrompts.en: Please provide the finalized commercial bid, technical bid, and formatting requirements. I will merge, format, generate TOC, check compliance, and produce the final document.
quickPrompts.zh: 请提供商务标书定稿、技术标书定稿和招标文件格式要求，我将进行合并排版、目录生成、格式合规检查，输出最终标书成稿。

quickPrompts.en: Check the document formatting against tender requirements: fonts, margins, headers, page numbers, and attachment order.
quickPrompts.zh: 检查文档格式是否符合招标要求：字体、页边距、页眉页脚、页码、附件顺序。

quickPrompts.en: Generate a table of contents with accurate page numbers and verify figure/table numbering continuity.
quickPrompts.zh: 生成含准确页码的目录，检查图表编号连续性。
